item.title: Suspicious pigeon with coded ring, Pak currency causes a flutter in Jammu
item.description: An official pointed out that such episodes are not uncommon in border areas of J&K and Punjab, where pigeons have been used for smuggling or for sending messages across the frontier. On Saturday, the pigeon was found near a temple in Samba’s border area of Mawa around 6.40am and was immediately captured by locals after they spotted a ring tied to its leg.
item.dc:creator: Sanjay Khajuria

item.title: Rs 10 lakh cover for 45 paise: Counter rail ticket buyers get insurance option
item.description: The scheme has provision for payment of Rs 7.5 lakh for permanent partial disability and up to Rs 2 lakh for hospitalisation expenses arising from injuries, as well as Rs 10,000 towards transportation of mortal remains of deceased passengers. The Railway Board has directed all its zones to implement the facility.

item.title: CBI files FIR against IL&FS Energy, top execs in Rs 212cr Canara Bank loan fraud case
item.description: CBI has named M/s IL&FS Energy Development Company Ltd, its MD and directors — Sunil Wadhwa, Anoop Seth, Hari Sankaran, Ramesh Chandra Bawa and Arun Kumar Saha — and unknown public servants and private individuals as accused. The case was registered on Oct 21 following a complaint by Canara Bank’s circle office in Bandra.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: ED moves Supreme Court against HC order to quash case against portal, founder
item.description: The directorate, which filed an appeal almost five months after the HC pronounced the order on May 29, also took the ground that the HC passed the order five months and 26 days after the judgement was reserved and it was in violation of SC’s guidelines that the verdict should be delivered within three months.
item.dc:creator: Amit Anand Choudhary

item.title: Defer Nov 1 rally, will hit festive business, traders urge Rahul; BJP raps Congress
item.description: CTI chairman Brijesh Goyal said Delhi records Rs 25,000 crore in business on Dhanteras across major sectors. CTI claimed that traders suffered losses of Rs 3,000 crore in Oct due to rallies and road closures in Connaught Place, India Gate and central Delhi. BJP claimed some Congress allies have disagreed with Rahul Gandhi’s decision to hold the rally on Nov 1.

item.title: Interview | ‘AAP had 4.5 years to end drug menace, gangsterism in Punjab’: Sachin Pilot
item.description: "BJP has no strong footing in Punjab and has survived on the back of SAD support. But SAD has also split and is facing internal issues. It is not the force like they were under Badal Senior. It will be a bipolar contest over who can lead Punjab better. There will be other players like Amritpal Singh’s party, but people of Punjab don’t give a fractured mandate," Sachin Pilot said.
item.dc:creator: Subodh Ghildiyal

item.title: No EC nod needed for voter to sue candidate over false information: Supreme Court
item.description: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu quashed the Karnataka HC order which had held that “right given to the voter is only to file an election petition, and not to register a private complaint of crime which is the duty of the Election Commission, if it wants to do so”.
item.dc:creator: Amit Anand Choudhary

item.title: Farooq Abdullah's comments on Pakistan and Kashmir draw flak
item.description: Farooq urged NC workers and legislators to remain loyal to the party, whether in power or not, as he touched on a range of issues in his speech. “Hold on to the truth. Speaking the truth is not easy, but unless you remain truthful and stand up for what is right, your future will never be secure,” the veteran said.
item.dc:creator: Naseer Ganai

item.title: Daughter’s inheritance rights can’t be defeated by limitation: J&K and Ladakh high court
item.description: The dispute dates back to Sept 14, 1982, when Themu, daughter of late Sonu, filed a civil suit claiming half share in land measuring 58 kanals and 11 marlas left behind by her father. She challenged mutation no. 43 dated Oct 15, 1966, which had been entered exclusively in favour of one Shib Devi and sought declaration of her inheritance rights along with consequential possession.
item.dc:creator: Sanjay Khajuria

item.title: Set to expand cabinet, J&K CM Omar Abdullah asks hopefuls not to ‘mob or spam’ him
item.description: J&K CM Omar Abdullah advised them against knocking on his doors or that of his father and National Conference president, Dr Farooq Abdullah, to lobby for ministerial positions. After meeting Sinha, Omar told reporters he sought an appointment with him for next week so that he can make changes and expand his council of ministers.

item.title: RG Kar victim's parents question ex-principal Sandip Ghosh's bail; citizens' groups plan CBI office march
item.description: The parents of the RG Kar victim are expressing their outrage over the bail granted to Sandip Ghosh, insisting that the investigation into their daughter's tragic death must be held accountable. Plans are underway for a protest organized by citizens' groups, pressing the Central Bureau of Investigation for urgent action. Family members and medical professionals alike have raised serious concerns regarding the efficacy and integrity of the ongoing investigation.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: ‘Act of treason’: BJP slams Farooq Abdullah over claim 'Pakistan is protecting Kashmiris'
item.description: In recent developments, BJP leaders have taken strong issue with Farooq Abdullah's comments regarding Pakistan's alleged support for Kashmiris. Abdullah, speaking at a workers' gathering, cast doubt on the central government's approach to Jammu and Kashmir, raising questions about India's commitment to justice. In response, BJP representatives charged him with treason, claiming his remarks weaken India's stance on the issue.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: Congress to launch door-to-door campaign, hold marches over voter list 'discrepancies'
item.description: Congress aims to register all eligible citizens by the end of December through an extensive campaign. The campaign will include marches, pamphlet distribution, and awareness meetings in both urban and rural areas. Booth-level agents will be appointed to help verify the accuracy of voter lists and report discrepancies. Allegations have arisen regarding significant irregularities affecting millions of voters across the country.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: NMC weighs five-year rotation of HoDs after stakeholder feedback
item.description: The National Medical Commission is considering an update to the rotation period for heads of departments in medical colleges. This revision aims to change the tenure from three years to five years based on stakeholder feedback. The original proposal also included both professors and eligible associate professors, which will now be restricted. A detailed response to an RTI application has confirmed that the proposal is still under consideration.
item.dc:creator: Anuja Jaiswal
